newsitem.title: USA: Henkel extends Loctite tender deadline.
newsitem.headline: Henkel extends Loctite tender deadline.

text.p: Henkel KGaA said Monday its HC Investments subsidiary extended the cash tender offer for all outstanding shares of Loctite Corp common stock until 1700 EST/2200 GMT on January 3, 1997, unless extended again.

As of December 20, which was the previous expiration date, some 16,379,946 shares had been tendered. Combined with shares already owned by HC Investments, the total number of shares account for about 86 percent of the outstanding Loctite common stock).
Henkel said a number of Loctite stockholders expressed a preference for selling the shares in 1997 for their own tax planning purposes.
Henkel said the merger could be done without a vote by Loctite stockholders if more than 90 perecnt of Loctite's outstanding stock is acquired in the tender offer.
